scored_against: the generator mask (mask_groundtruth.png) that forward replay is scored against, not the detector polygon
coordinate_convention: outlines lie on the edges of the scene's pixel cells, the cells the rasteriser assigns particles to
note: One forcing member of six. mean_iou in attribution_result.json averages all six members, so nominal_iou differs from it; both come from the same rasterisation. A release position is null where the track has no fix bracketing that time.
